column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3578): one subtest per dialect with an operator-key store (postgres, mssql; MySQL is single-tenant by decision), each through newKeysFixture -> testutil.TestDB, which skips when its DSN is unset. test-go/support configures PostgreSQL only, so mssql skips once per test while postgres RUNS -- two tests, one skip each. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set: go test ./auth/ -run '^(TestARecoveryKeyIsMintedOnlyForATenantWithNoLiveKey|TestARecoveryMintRacesAreDecidedUnderTheTenantsRowLock)$' -count=1 -json reports skip for /mssql and nothing else skipped. Same shape as TestAScopedOperatorKeyRoundTripsOnEveryDialect.
